title: Ingestion queue message
description: Message node-api puts on the ingestion queue (AZURE_STORAGE_QUEUE_NAME) after storing an uploaded PDF in Blob storage and inserting a processing_jobs row. python-worker consumes it. The message body is UTF-8 JSON text.

schema_version.description: Version of this message contract. Bump it on breaking changes.

job_id.description: processing_jobs row this message belongs to. The worker updates that row's status.

document_id.description: Stable ID of the document. Re-ingesting the same document reuses it, so chunk IDs and KPI rows are overwritten instead of duplicated.

blob_container.description: Container holding the PDF (normally the value of AZURE_STORAGE_BLOB_CONTAINER).

blob_name.description: Blob name (path) of the PDF inside blob_container.

company.description: Company stock ticker, upper case (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, TSLA). Supplied by the uploader.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year the report covers. Supplied by the uploader.

original_filename.description: File name as uploaded, for display only.

enqueued_at.description: When node-api enqueued the message (RFC 3339, UTC).
